name: Echoform Character Parameter - Maximum Modifier Intensity
description: Validates character parameter at maximum (1.0) scales modifier intensity correctly. Tests with multiple modifiers active at full intensity.

capability_requirements.notes: Tests character parameter at 1.0 with wow/flutter and dropout modifiers

modifier_active.description: Period with modifiers at full intensity

has_output.description: Output should be audible despite dropout modifier

no_clipping.description: Maximum character intensity should not cause clipping

high_variance.description: Character=1.0 should create high variance (wow/flutter + dropout active)

spectral_modulation.description: Wow/flutter should modulate spectral content of sweep

expected_discontinuities.description: Dropout modifier creates intentional discontinuities (expected at character=1.0)

use_cases: Verify character parameter scales modifier intensity (test at 1.0 = max)
Test multiple modifiers at full intensity (wow/flutter + dropout)
Validate stability with extreme modifier settings
Ensure no clipping at maximum character value
pass_criteria: High variance output from modifiers, spectral modulation from wow/flutter, controlled dropout artifacts, no clipping
example_failures: Low variance → character parameter not scaling modifiers
No discontinuities → dropout modifier not active
Clipping → gain issue at full character intensity
Static spectral content → wow/flutter not working
